name: manage-pane
description: Adds task tools (task_create, task_update, task_list) and a pane that shows the session's tasks with the subagents working them, and the instruction files the context loaded with their sizes; /pane opens or closes it

open_on_start.title: Open the pane at session start
open_on_start.description: Open the pane when an interactive session starts. Off: it opens with the first task of a list, or with /pane.
